noProjectToAdd: This block has no project to add a block to.
textsHeld: This project’s texts are being edited on the page “{page}”: publish it or discard its changes first.
projectHeld: This project is being edited on the page “{page}”: publish it or discard its changes first.
removed: Block deleted. Undo brings it back.
dropHint: Drop the files on a project, between two images or on an empty slot.

pickerHelp: Choose this block’s project: its title, introduction and images come from it (texts and images are edited afterwards on the page). A project created here becomes public together with the page.
imageBgTitle: Background behind this image (useful for a cut-out PNG)
addToProject: Add a block to the project
stripHint: Images and videos chosen from your media library.
projectImagesHint: Brings back the project’s images, with their captions.
panoFitTitle: The whole image is visible, without exceeding the carousel
panoScrollTitle: The image keeps its size and is revealed by scrolling
